name: nft-jump-jump-sub-two-subs
description: jump-sub with a chain that jumps on to a second one that drops
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add chain inet f sub
nft add chain inet f sub2
nft add rule inet f sub2 ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
nft add rule inet f sub jump sub2

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out jump sub
